title: How to Negotiate a New Truck Price in 2026 (8 Steps Dealers Hope You Skip)
description:
Right now, some dealers are offering zero percent financing for five years on a new Ram fifteen hundred and a Chevy Silverado. A twenty twenty-five Ford Lightning carries eight thousand dollars cash back. A lease ad shows a full-size Chevy for three hundred twenty-nine dollars a month, with almost ten thousand dollars due at signing. The deals are out there in late twenty twenty-six. The question is whether you know how to get them.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]
